title: C14 valuation-date variant
description: Catalog row c14-outputs 1.0.0: one valuation date of the IRRBB case on a USD balance sheet (outputs.kind valuation-date), real FDIC aggregates and synthetic behaviour.

c14Label.description: A non-empty bilingual label (an empty string is not a label).

c14Sign.description: Sign convention, stated in the document: a positive delta EVE or delta NII is a loss (SRP31.129; dossier 01 H.4).

c14Units.description: Units of every number: money in the stated scale of its currency, rates as decimals discounted continuously (SRP31.129), shocks in basis points, bucket midpoints in years, dates ISO.

c14Assumption.description: A behavioural assumption as a named field: its value, its unit and where it comes from (the regulatory cap, a fit, or a stated synthetic value), so a view can show the result with and without it.

c14Assumptions.description: The five behavioural assumptions. nmd_core_share and nmd_core_maturity_years are the balance-weighted averages of nmd_segments.

bucket.description: Bucket of the 19 of SRP31.96 Table 3, 1 (overnight) to 19 (over 20 years).

midpoint_years.description: Bucket midpoint in years: one of the 19 of SRP31.96 Table 3.

amount.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c14Flow.description: A net notional repricing cash flow in one bucket (assets positive, liabilities negative).

balance.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

requested_core_share.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

core_share_cap.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

core_share_used.description: A share or an observed rate in [0, 1].

c14NmdSegment.description: A non-maturity deposit segment: the requested core share and maturity, the SRP31 Table 4 cap, the value used and cap_applied (D2 of the U10 sizing). A request above its cap validates only with cap_applied true and the used value at the cap; a request within the caps has cap_applied false and the used value equal to the request (a producer check). The standardised EVE uses the used values.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

c14ShockSize.description: The shock sizes applied to a currency, in basis points. A tabled size is exactly the table's (SRP31.90 Table 2, d368 Annex 2 Table 1, RAN 21-13 Annex 1 Hoja 9); a currency without an entry in the BCBS table (CLP is in neither) passes only labelled as a Contraste estimate with its method, never as a regulatory parameter (dossier 01 H.3), and a tabled currency cannot be relabelled as an estimate.

tier1.description: Money in the `currency` of the enclosing block.

eve_risk_measure.description: Money in the `currency` of the enclosing block.

c14Outlier.description: The outlier test: the EVE risk measure against 15 percent of Tier 1 capital (SRP31.82 to SRP31.83).

c14DynItem.description: One item of the dynamic NII projection (the inputs of simulate_nii): a reset rate is spread + beta x r_t; reprice_months 0 reprices every month, k >= 1 keeps rate0 until month k and resets every k months.

short_rate_path.description: Annual short rate of each projected month, after the floor.

monthly_nii.description: NII of each projected month, money.

total.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

delta_vs_base.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c14DynScenario.description: The projected NII under the base path or one parallel shock; delta_vs_base = base total minus this total (loss-positive).

c14DynScenarios.description: base, parallel-up, parallel-down, in that order.

c14BsAssumption.description: The balance-sheet assumption of the projection: a constant balance sheet (maturing or repricing flows replaced by identical new ones, DIS70.5) or an annual growth.

c14Bank.description: The bank of the case (real FDIC aggregates, synthetic behaviour: SDD section 5).

c14Report.description: One FDIC call-report quarter read for the case and the financials fields taken from it.

c14Data.description: The call reports read for the valuation date. Never one dated after it: data_cutoff is the latest report date read and is on or before the valuation date (a producer test checks the dates; a false flag fails).

c14Point.description: One tenor of the curve: the observed par yield and the continuously compounded zero rate.

zero_rates_at_midpoints.description: Zero rate at each bucket midpoint, bucket 1 first.

c14Curve.description: The US Treasury par yield curve of the valuation date, bootstrapped to continuously compounded zero rates and read at the 19 midpoints. Tenors the date lacks are listed, never filled silently (dossier 08 C.2).

anyOf.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c14Item.description: One balance-sheet item slotted into the buckets. A call-report item the FDIC financials lack has reported_amount null with its reason and the slotting assumption that replaces it, never a fabricated number; a reported item has no reason. cash_flows under behavioural and contractual (every NMD in the overnight bucket) are net notional flows.

total_assets.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

total_liabilities.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c14BalanceSheet.description: The slotted balance sheet of the valuation date.

bucket.description: Bucket of the 19 of SRP31.96 Table 3, 1 (overnight) to 19 (over 20 years).

midpoint_years.description: Bucket midpoint in years: one of the 19 of SRP31.96 Table 3.

assets.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

liabilities.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

gap.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c14GapRow.description: Repricing gap of one bucket: assets, liabilities and their difference (dossier 05 D.1).

asset_value.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

liability_value.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

equity_change_100bp_up.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c14DurationGap.description: Duration gap DGAP = D_A - (L / A) D_L and the first-order change in equity for +100 bp, -DGAP x A x 0.01 (dossier 05 D.2).

delta_nii_gap_100bp_up.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c14Ladder.description: Rungs 1 and 2 of the IRRBB ladder under one NMD assumption. delta_nii_gap_100bp_up is loss-positive: -sum over t_k < 1 of G_k x 0.01 x (1 - t_k).

shape_bp.description: Shock in basis points at each bucket midpoint before the floor.

items.description: Bucket of the 19 of SRP31.96 Table 3, 1 (overnight) to 19 (over 20 years).

floor_bound_buckets.description: Buckets where the post-shock floor binds.

items.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

net_cash_flows.description: One value per bucket, bucket 1 first; net notional repricing cash flows, assets positive, liabilities negative.

eve.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

kao.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

delta_eve.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

anyOf.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c14ShockResult.description: The result of one prescribed shock: net_cash_flows are the scenario cash flows (the term-deposit redemption multiplier of SRP31.125 moves cash flows), eve = sum CF x exp(-R t), delta_eve = EVE_0 - EVE_i + KAO (positive is a loss). delta_nii exists for the two parallel shocks only (SRP31.90) and is null with its reason otherwise.

c14DynamicNii.description: Ladder rung 5 (dossier 05 D.6): the monthly NII over 12 to 36 months under the base path and the two parallel shocks of the 2024 calibration, run-off replaced under the stated balance-sheet assumption, deposit betas in the items. Every path and monthly NII has horizon_months values.

nii_quantile.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

eve_quantile.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

ear.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

evar.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

ear_se.description: Monte Carlo standard error of ear, money (engine ear_evar_mc_error).

evar_se.description: Monte Carlo standard error of evar, money (engine ear_evar_mc_error).

c14EarEvarLevel.description: EaR and EVaR at one confidence level: ear = base NII minus the (1 - level) quantile of the NII paths, evar likewise for EVE (loss-positive; engine ear_evar).

base_nii.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

base_eve.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c14EarEvar.description: Ladder rung 6 (dossier 05 D.5 and D.6): the distribution summary of NII and EVE under Hull-White one-factor or dynamic Nelson-Siegel scenario Monte Carlo, with the number of paths, the seed and, at each level, the Monte Carlo standard error of EaR and EVaR by batch means over n_batches contiguous batches of paths.

anyOf.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.
Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c14OutOfSample.description: The out-of-sample row: the NII projection of this valuation date against the NII realised in the following period (the 2022 hiking cycle for 2021-Q4), read from call reports dated after the valuation date and used only here, never as an input. Not applicable (null with its reason) when no later period is read.

floor.description: Post-shock floor, not above zero (SRP31.93); null: none.

base_eve.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

shocks.description: The six shocks in the order of SHOCKS.

eve_risk_measure.description: Money in the `currency` of the enclosing block.

c14Scenario.description: nmd_treatment says what the behavioural flows use: the capped used values of nmd_segments (standardised-capped) or every NMD in the overnight bucket (contractual-overnight). One calibration of the shock sizes under one NMD assumption: the six shocks in the order parallel-up, parallel-down, steepener, flattener, short-up, short-down, the EVE risk measure (the maximum over the six of the positive losses, SRP31.129) and its outlier test.

delta_eve_behavioural.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

delta_eve_contractual.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

difference.description: Money in the `currency` (C15: the `reporting_currency`) of the enclosing block.

c14Comparison.description: Delta EVE with and without the behavioural NMD assumptions, always reported (dossier 05 D.7); difference = behavioural minus contractual.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the money fields of this block.

scenarios.description: 2024 and 2016 calibrations, each with and without behavioural NMD, in this order.

c14Outputs.description: C14 valuation-date outputs (outputs.kind valuation-date): IRRBB on a USD balance sheet at one valuation date, the six shocks of SRP31.90 in two calibrations and with and without behavioural NMD. The variant is the valuation date (the call reports are dated); the calibration and the NMD assumption are rows inside it so a view toggles them on one balance sheet.
